title: Player Perspectives
dek: Journals, recollections, research and public arguments: what people recorded, believed and remembered about Fenumion.

body:
These notes preserve how Fenumion looked to the people writing about it. Witnesses, journal writers and later commentators can disagree, misunderstand an event or revise their views. Their accounts belong alongside the wider history without becoming an omniscient version of it.

261 indexed posts28 January 2024 – 5 October 2026 · Discord #story-notes

Posted is not happened. Dates below identify when a note was posted, not necessarily when its events occurred.

An excerpt is not the whole note. These are the supplied index’s short locators. Open the Discord message for its full context; some linked or attached material is not included.

Keep the writer’s perspective. Author names are preserved as supplied display names, not independently confirmed character identities. Source forms and topic labels are retrieval aids, not canon classifications.

Browse the notes

Read alongside the history

Compare a writer’s account with the timeline, character histories and faction records. A contemporary impression and a later recollection can both matter without saying the same thing. Early references to “the Vanguard of Prima Isle” are preserved as the writers’ wording; the index does not establish their relationship to later formations called vanguards.
